evidence.reference_title: Dieulafoy Lesion: Scope it Until You Find it.
evidence.snippet: A Dieulafoy lesion is an aberrant vessel that does not reduce in caliber when it extends from the submucosa to the mucosa. Damage to this artery can result in severe, intermittent arterial bleeding from tiny, difficult-to-visualize vessel stumps.
